task: Fix 58 errors in src/wasm/assembly/types.ts (f64/i32/bool not found) by excluding src/wasm/assembly/** from tsconfig.json
notes: Added top-level exclude ['src/wasm/assembly/**'] to tsconfig.json. These are AssemblyScript files (not regular TypeScript) and use AssemblyScript-only types like f64/i32/bool that tsc cannot resolve. wasm/assembly error count: 59 -> 0. Total tsc errors: 75 -> 13 (drop of 62; user expected ~58, the extra drop is from cascading 'Cannot find name' errors that disappeared once the file was excluded). Did not modify the wasm file itself.
